deadline.value: The page gives only the Fall 2026 deadline of February 1, 2026, which has passed; no Fall 2027 date is posted.

also.quote: Priority Admission Deadline: Applications for admission to the Ph.D. in Data Science program in Fall 2026 must be received by February 1, 2026

app_fee.value: The processing fee for international applicants is $85.

gre_general.value: A GRE aptitude score above the 50th percentile is required, waived only for US degree holders with a 3.0 undergraduate or 3.5 graduate GPA, or a terminal degree, on written request.
gre_general.quote: A satisfactory score (above the 50th percentile) on the aptitude portion of the GRE

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The page lists a TOEFL iBT of 83, an old-scale value replaced by the new 4.5 scale, so no current TOEFL minimum is recorded.

ielts_min.value: The program requires an IELTS Academic overall band score of 6.5 or higher.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: Overall band score of 6.5 or higher

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission; applicants may contact faculty.

also.quote: Prospective students are welcome to reach out to faculty members to discuss their research interests and fit with the program

funding.value: Admitted, well-qualified full-time students are typically offered tuition, health insurance and a TA; part-time students are not eligible.
funding.quote: Admitted, well-qualified Ph.D. students are typically offered a funding package that covers tuition, health insurance, and a Teaching Assistantship (TA)

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with an undergraduate GPA of 3.2 or higher, or a relevant master's degree, is accepted.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree from a college or university accredited by an accepted accrediting body, with an undergraduate GPA of 3.2 or higher
